name: The French Dip (Roast Beef & Swiss Melt)
whyItWorks: Dipping the bread in warm broth pre-softens the entire meal before you even swallow.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm thin deli roast beef in a mug of beef broth/au jus. Pile onto a soft white French roll with melted Swiss cheese (toaster oven for 3 mins). Dip every bite.
